facts_found: Goods or Services Not Received (paid but never received) is an accepted reason to file a credit card transaction dispute. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]
Rho-Bank recommends contacting the merchant first, but if contact was unsuccessful the customer should file a dispute right away. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

Customer-facing channels to start a dispute: 1-800-RHO-BANK, in-app chat, or rhobank.com/help; agent gathers purchase date, merchant name, amount and account info. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_018]

Internal procedure: agent gathers comprehensive information, first unlocks the tool file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829, then calls it via call_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name and a JSON string of all required arguments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

Required arguments for file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829: transaction_id, card_action, card_last_4_digits, full_name, user_id, phone, email, address, contacted_merchant, purchase_date, issue_noticed_date, dispute_reason, resolution_requested, partial_refund_amount (optional, only for partial_refund), eligible_for_provisional_credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
dispute_reason 'goods_services_not_received' means 'Never received what was paid for'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

card_action 'keep_active' is used when the customer wants to keep the card active and only dispute the charge; 'cancel_and_reissue' is used when the card is cancelled/replaced. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]
eligible_for_provisional_credit must be determined by the agent using the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines article. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

[doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]
Silver Rewards Card is Mid Tier with a maximum provisional credit of $5000.00. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

A 'goods_services_not_received' dispute where the purchase was made within the last 30 days is NOT eligible for provisional credit (merchant may still be processing delivery). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Provisional credit is a temporary credit applied while the dispute is investigated; it becomes permanent if resolved in the customer's favor and is reversed otherwise. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_022]

Use get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id) to retrieve all credit card disputes filed by the user, needed to check the 'no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months' criterion. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]
After a dispute-related credit is resolved, a statement credit can be applied with apply_statement_credit_8472 using reason 'dispute_resolution'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

facts_found: Customer-facing CLI request path: gather current credit card account information, the new total limit or increase dollar amount, and a brief reason; then contact Rho-Bank support via secure in-app chat, secure message from the online account, or phone; ask the agent to confirm submission and provide a reference confirmation. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]
Only the account owner or an authorized account manager may submit a CLI request for the account. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

After submission Rho-Bank reviews the account and reason and sends a decision by email within a few business days; if approved the new limit takes effect as soon as the change is processed; if denied the customer gets an explanation and when they may reapply. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_004]

Agent workflow (exact order): Step 0 confirm requested amount is within tier limits (do NOT submit if it exceeds); Step 1 submit the request with submit_credit_limit_increase_request_7392; Step 2 verify basic eligibility (account age, cooldown, no pending disputes, no pending replacement cards, account current/no past-due, utilization below tier max); Step 3 verify payment history and requested amount; Step 4 approve with approve_credit_limit_increase_5847 or deny with deny_credit_limit_increase_5848; Step 5 communicate the decision. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

submit_credit_limit_increase_request_7392 arguments: credit_card_account_id (string, required), user_id (string, required), requested_increase_amount (integer, required) — the dollar amount BY WHICH to increase the limit, not the new total. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

get_credit_limit_increase_history_4829 argument: credit_card_account_id (string, required); used to check whether a prior CLI request falls inside the tier cooldown period. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

approve_credit_limit_increase_5847 arguments: credit_card_account_id (string, required), user_id (string, required), new_credit_limit (float, required) — the new TOTAL credit limit to set. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

deny_credit_limit_increase_5848 arguments: credit_card_account_id (string, required), user_id (string, required), denial_reason (string, required) with allowed values 'insufficient_account_age', 'cooldown_period_active', 'pending_disputes', 'pending_replacement_card', 'past_due_balance', 'high_utilization', 'insufficient_payment_history', 'requested_amount_exceeds_limit', 'other'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

Maximum CLI increase per request: Entry-tier 25% of current credit limit; Mid-tier 50% of current credit limit; Premium-tier 50% of current credit limit. If the customer requests more, inform them of the maximum and ask whether to proceed at that amount. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

Payment history requirement: Entry-tier 6 consecutive months of on-time payments; Mid-tier 3 consecutive months; Premium-tier 3 consecutive months. Verified with get_payment_history_6183(credit_card_account_id, months). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

CLI eligibility by tier (all three must be met at submission): Entry-tier min account age 120 days, cooldown 120 days, utilization below 70%; Mid-tier 90 days, 90 days, below 80%; Premium-tier 60 days, 60 days, below 90%. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]

The CLI cooldown applies only if the most recent request was APPROVED; denied requests do not trigger a cooldown, and it is counted from the date the last CLI request was submitted. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
Utilization must be strictly BELOW the tier threshold; utilization at or above the threshold does not qualify. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_005]
Silver Rewards Card is a Mid-tier card (listed in the Mid Tier group alongside Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

Silver Rewards Card approved credit limits generally fall between $10,000 and $100,000 based on credit profile and underwriting, so a $22,500 total limit is within the card's documented range. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_007]

For this customer: current line $15,000 and desired line $22,500 implies requested_increase_amount = 7500, which equals exactly 50% of the current limit — the Mid-tier maximum — so the request is within limits and may be submitted. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_006]

The credit_card_account_id needed by the CLI tools is obtained from the customer's account profile or by looking up their credit card accounts (get_credit_card_accounts_by_user). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

A pending credit card transaction dispute on the account is a disqualifying condition for a CLI ('No Pending Disputes' eligibility check; denial reason 'pending_disputes'). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_007]

open_questions: The customer's credit_card_account_id and user_id are still required inputs for all CLI tools (look up via get_credit_card_accounts_by_user).
Account-specific eligibility data is unknown: account opening date, prior approved CLI date, current utilization/balance, past-due status, active disputes, and pending replacement cards.
